# Book Development Status {.unnumbered}

This book is being developed alongside the Fall 2026 offering of
ME/BME 736: Advanced Finite Element Methods. The status below indicates how
much of each chapter has been developed and reviewed. It will be updated as the
book progresses.

For this page, **complete** means that a chapter has a full working draft
suitable for use in the course. Complete chapters may still receive
copyediting, additional examples, improved exercises, and revisions needed for
consistency with later chapters.

## Complete

- **[Chapter 1: Introduction to the Finite Element Method](chapters/01-introduction.qmd#sec-introduction)**
- **[Chapter 2: Mathematical Foundations](chapters/02-mathematical-foundations.qmd#sec-math-foundations)**
- **[Chapter 3: Partial Differential Equations and Variational Formulations](chapters/03-variational-formulations.qmd#sec-variational)**
- **[Chapter 4: Model Problems in Heat Transfer and Solid Mechanics](chapters/04-model-problems.qmd#sec-model-problems)**
- **[Chapter 5: The Finite Element Method in One Dimension](chapters/05-finite-element-review.qmd#sec-one-dimensional-fem)**
- **[Chapter 6: Finite Element Approximation in Multiple Dimensions](chapters/06-multidimensional-fem.qmd#sec-multidimensional-fem)**
- **[Chapter 7: A Priori Error Estimation and Convergence](chapters/07-apriori-error.qmd#sec-apriori-error)**
- **[Chapter 8: A Posteriori Error Estimation and Adaptive Finite Elements](chapters/08-aposteriori-adaptivity.qmd#sec-aposteriori-adaptivity)**
- **[Chapter 9: Nonlinear Finite Element Methods](chapters/11-nonlinear-fem.qmd#sec-nonlinear-fem)**

## Yet to be started

The material through a posteriori error estimation and adaptivity has been
covered in the course. The following chapters still contain placeholders:

- **[Chapter 10: Transient Finite Element Methods](chapters/12-transient-fem.qmd#sec-transient-fem)**
